title: Appelsiinimarmelaadia (Orange Marmalade)
description: A fruit preserve made with oranges, lemons, and sugar.

Peel and remove the white part of the peel.

Drain without stirring through a fine cheese cloth.

Fill the glass jars, cover as directed.
Serve with tea and toast.

Pour the mixture into a fine straining cloth to drip by itself.
Cook the juice obtained and the strips of fruit peel with its liquid and sugar for 15 minutes stirring constantly.
Pour the marmalade into small jars and preserve as usual.
Serve with tea and toast.
